tasks.gr10-study-skills-methods-t2: Topic: Study Skills and Study Methods. Cover study skills (listening, reading and comprehension, concentration, memory, organisation, time management), study methods (note-taking, mind-mapping, selecting important concepts, constructing an assignment or essay, making comparisons), critical, creative and problem-solving skills, the process of assessment (internal assessment set and marked by the school and moderated, external assessment set and marked outside the school; Life Orientation is assessed internally only, with a task out of 80 and the PET out of 20 in each term, so each term is out of 100 and the year out of 400), and building an annual study plan. Ask Grade 10 learners to match a study skill to a situation, order the steps of an essay or of problem-solving, tell internal from external assessment, work out a term or year mark, or add up the time in a study timetable.
tasks.gr10-social-environmental-responsibility: Topic: Social and Environmental Responsibility. Cover social justice and environmental justice, contemporary social issues that harm local and global communities (crime, poverty, food security and food production, violence, HIV and AIDS, safety and security, unequal access to basic resources, a lack of basic services such as water and health services), their harmful effects on personal and community health, the social, constructive and critical thinking skills needed for civic life, youth service, volunteerism and the steps of a group project on a social issue. Ask Grade 10 learners to identify an example of social or environmental injustice, link a social issue to its effect on health, choose a responsible response to a rumour or a community problem, or order the steps of a group project.
tasks.gr10-physical-education-t2: Topic: Physical Education: Games and Safety. Cover playground, community and indigenous games and the movement skills and fitness each one trains (coordination, balance, agility, speed, throwing and catching, aim and accuracy), teamwork, recording movement performance and improvement, fair play and inclusion, and safety in games (checking the playing area, equipment, warm-up, water, sun protection, stopping when a player is hurt). Ask Grade 10 learners to match a game to the skill it trains, work out an improvement from a record, explain fair play or inclusion, or choose the safe action before or during a game.
